policy_input_vectors.layout: one length-4 evidence vector per agent, in the order below, appended to that agent's observation

evidence.integration_boundary: This creates real-dataset evidence for agent roles. The current learned LACD checkpoint was trained in FactorySim and is not automatically validated or retrained on these heterogeneous real datasets.

caveats: ZeMA predicted class IDs are not translated into fault severity without verified class semantics.
Future Factories assembly classes are not treated as throughput labels.
HIPE forecasts power, not carbon intensity or energy price.
Smart Manufacturing flags unsupervised anomalies; it has no ground-truth fault labels.
Semiconductor tables are static metadata, not live observations.
The policy is trained on FactorySim rewards; real datasets only condition its observations.
Health-risk, latency and carbon values are simulator proxies, not measurements.
This is a research prototype, not MAPPO.
